headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of October 15, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 26.37% compared to SPY's 13.90%. This 12.47% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 42.35%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned only 4.22%, highlighting a disparity in performance among the portfolios. Outperforming a broad benchmark like SPY is particularly relevant during times of market stress and uncertainty, as it reflects the portfolio's resilience in challenging conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
